description: Java class 'SharedAccountWorkBookPopulator' that extends 'AbstractWorkbookPopulator' and is responsible for populating an Excel workbook with shared account data, including setting up sheets, layouts, validation rules, and referencing external data sources within the project.

classes.name: SharedAccountWorkBookPopulator
classes.description: A class responsible for populating an Excel workbook with shared account data, setting layouts, rules, defaults, and external references within a bulk import process.

methods.name: SharedAccountWorkBookPopulator
methods.description: Constructor initializing sheet populators for shared products, clients, and savings accounts.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Main method to populate the workbook with sheets, layout, rules, and default values.

methods.name: setDefaults
methods.description: Sets default formulas for specific columns in the shared accounts sheet across many rows.

methods.name: setRules
methods.description: Defines data validation rules for specific columns, including formulas and date constraints.

methods.name: setNames
methods.description: Creates named ranges for clients and shared products, and for each shared product, creates related named formulas.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Defines the header row layout with column widths and header titles.
